name: Sągi jodłowych kłód (skład drewna)
description: A stack of silver fir logs at a timber yard, each about 4 m long and 0.4 m thick, some with bark, some stripped; cut ends with growth rings and axe marks. Fir and pine for hulls and oars, oak for keels (Theophrastus, Historia plantarum 5.7.1-3, late 4th century BC).
